messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick note: launching a short comms + tracker for voluntary benefits enrollment changes (dental/vision carriers). Enrollment window: Aug 2 - Aug 16. No policy change to eligibility, just carriers and instructions.

clara (Benefits): Link to enrollment guide + tracker: https://tiny.redwood/vol-benefits-2026. Managers: please confirm any contractors on benefits-eligible contracts and mark them in the sheet.

ryan (Hiring Ops): Heads-up: offer templates need a one-liner about the new carrier switch and the 14-day enrollment window for new hires. We'll push an updated offer snippet tomorrow.

tom (Eng Manager): For folks who miss the window but have qualifying life events, do we default to retroactive enrollment or require manual casework?

clara (Benefits): Standard: qualifying events handled case-by-case; we'll do manual enrollments with proof. Add questions to the tracker if you foresee cases.

anya (People Ops): Also updating handbook FAQ under Benefits to show carrier contact info and effective dates. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/711. Expect merge by Jul 28.

ryan (Hiring Ops): Can ops-bot create a CSV export after enrollment closes for Payroll/HRIS? We need enrollments to flow into payroll for deductions starting Sep payroll.

ops-bot: Export scheduled: /internal/hr/exports/vol_benefits_enrollments_2026-08-17.csv next run 2026-08-17T03:00Z :robot_face:

clara (Benefits): Payroll needs: user_id, plan_code, effective_date, deduction_amount, contractor_flag. Added to export template.

tom (Eng Manager): Please drop a manager reminder two days before deadline in the team channels. Small nudge helps.

anya (People Ops): Scheduled manager nudge for 2026-08-14. Template: "Reminder: voluntary benefits enrollment closes Aug 16. Confirm your team's choices in the tracker: <link>. Contact benefits@redwood.com for questions."

ops-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by ops-bot

anya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll post a short company-wide note after the handbook PR merges.
